title: Bare translation-invariant based-gauge BRST has zero L2 state cohomology and no gap

obstruction.hilbert_factor: L2(R^m,dchi) for finitely many based-gauge coordinates, tensored with a finite ghost exterior algebra
obstruction.bare_differential: d0=sum_j partial_(chi_j) wedge e_j on the Sobolev domain
obstruction.degree_zero_kernel: d0 Psi=0 makes Psi constant in every chi_j; the only constant in L2(R^m,dchi) is zero
obstruction.spectral_sequence: Normalized Fourier packets supported in |p|<=1/n obey ||p Psi_n||<=1/n, so zero lies in continuous spectrum and there is no positive BRST gap
obstruction.range: The derivative range is dense but not closed, since the multiplier p approaches zero without a zero eigenvector
obstruction.meaning: Naive invariant L2 vectors divide by an infinite noncompact gauge volume and cannot realize the nonzero reduced state space
obstruction.boundary: This excludes only the bare translation-invariant state representation, not reduced quantization, rigging maps, Gaussian gauge fixing or Krein BRST constructions
